subject: Rise over the plate
angle: flat-lay reveal: crane up with a tilt from 45 degrees to overhead
motion: flat-lay reveal: crane up with a tilt from 45 degrees to overhead
focal_point: Target hero in the protected middle band
golden_ratio: Use the prescribed center, thirds or functional three-point arrangement; no decorative spiral
lighting: Fixed light; restrained explicit window/fixture cues only
handover: None: P0 ends on this shot target
source_setup:
- **Composition**: plate at the place setting, centred left-right; fork straight, parallel to the plate's left side, 4 cm from the rim; cup on its saucer at one o'clock, handle right. Triangle markers on the plate centre, the cup centre and the fork's middle.
- **Start**: seat side, straight in front of the plate, phone pitched 45 degrees down, lens 0.45 m from the plate centre.
- **Move**: one crane up with a tilt over the full 6 s, eased in and out; the plate stays at the same place in the frame.
- **End**: phone flat above the plate, no roll; plate rim 0.55 of the frame width, plate centre at 55% of the frame height; whole cup, saucer and fork in frame with at least 4% margin; lens at most 0.70 m above the plate.
- **Objects**: the shared example dish as in plate_low_push_in, rearranged for this guide only. No hands, no people.
adaptations: Crane up with tilt in the seat-side vertical plane: pitch 45 to 90 degrees, the plate held at 55% of the frame height; a fixed tabletop up reference keeps the overhead end free of roll.
